notes.title: Patch 1.2 is up to date !!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.2 is up to date! Hello everyone, Patch 1.2 is ready. What will you find in this Update?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png 2 new boats: The Twistales boat and a promotional boat with our UPDATE IT partner in Clermont-Ferrand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png 1 modification of the old LDLC boat which becomes BOAT 98.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Added rain in weather options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Overall game performance improvements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png UI redesign. Which are now scalable
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Added world best timer GHOST. You will now be able to see how the best player in the world managed to do much better than you.

Enjoy!!!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
The first Riding Seas’ patch note arrives Monday, April 4, 2022! 

On the menu :

:check:  New imput system supporting all types of controllers! 
:check:  Integration of the remote system. You can now invite friends to your games to play up to 4 via Steam.
:check:  Tutorial update : 
  Ability to quit after one lap, bug fixes, reworked explanatory panels. 
:check:  Mirror mode now displays ingame. 
:check:  Career difficulty adjustment: advance and master modes go from 5 to 4 turns.
:check:  New display for Time Attack: 
 You will now know with which boat the best time was achieved. 
 The best time is displayed in the circuit selection. 
 Correction of the strobe effect. 
:check:  10 new Steam Achievements.
:check:  1 new boat, the Patricia, unlockable by completing the “All Grand Prix” Achievement.
:check:  3 new languages: Italian, Portuguese and German.
:check:  Many bugs fixed.

notes.title: Patch Note close BETA 0.98
notes.notes:
Almost 2 months have passed since our last STEAM FEST Update in October!

But why did you wait so long? Following a very large number of requests and in order to bring the game to other platforms, we have rethought the heart of the game in order to offer you a local multiplayer mode up to 4 in split screen.
It is with great joy that today we can present the following PATCH Notes to you. There are so many new features that we couldn't list everything for you, but here is a non-exhaustive list of what to expect if you have obviously requested a BETA Key!
ːsteammockingː 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Changed the core of the game. Single races can now be played up to 8.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Modification of the circuit selection menu to allow you to configure your route.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png   Implementation of the game translation tool: French version has 80% translated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png  Improvement of the Shipyard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png  Implementation of the Mirror mode, accessible via the Single Race and the time attack.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Fixed various navigation bugs.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Numerous adjustments and visual corrections of some maps: (Green arrows, new buoys, improvement of Italian canal, Golden Valley ...)
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Added the ability to disable the game interface.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Added many animations in the game menu.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png Addition of a local battle mode, with the possibility of playing up to 4 in split screen.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.pngChanged the time attack interface to compare to other players in real time.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png the ghost now changes depending on the selected boat.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png  collision corrections.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/2c78ff12ae1878e4c736c08926d38fbba64743da.png  and lots of other things to discover ....!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/dcf5ca875fdb4779aefec5f98fb8129f1c29e5d7.png

We still have beta keys available until December 31, 2021. Join us on DISCORD: https://discord.gg/24j5ptr  And request your Key! !

notes.title: Patch note beta demo 0.94
notes.notes:
A number of bugs were reported to us following the launch of the demo at the start of NEO FEST.
We planned the release of Patch Note 0.94 in Day1, but it took longer than expected to deploy.
We are sorry for the inconvenience!
ːSteamthumbsupː The patch is now live and we hope you can enjoy the full potential of our demo.

If you don't see this version of the game:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38855502/dac3e8e618b57475895c7ff63cdd453b824b3567.jpg
Uninstall the game to start over on the correct version.
